lessons.title: Useful intermediate vocabulary

cards.translation: This problem is not my own matter.
cards.explanation: Use the pattern 자기/자신, 훨씬, 관련하다, 주위, 일단, 전혀/별로.

cards.translation: This class is related to Korean culture.
cards.explanation: Use the pattern 자기/자신, 훨씬, 관련하다, 주위, 일단, 전혀/별로.

cards.translation: There is a park around the house.
cards.explanation: Use the pattern 자기/자신, 훨씬, 관련하다, 주위, 일단, 전혀/별로.

lessons.title: Expressing possibility with ~ㄹ/을 것 같다
lessons.explanation: A concise practice lesson based on the HTSK Lesson 35 topic. Read the original explanation for additional detail.

cards.translation: It seems like it will rain tomorrow.

cards.translation: The teacher is coming now.

cards.translation: Please sit here.
